INCIDENT REPORT -- Basalt Ridge Mining Co., Processing Building 2
Date: 2026-05-09 | Filed by: Naledi Dube, Site EHS Coordinator

At 13:05, an electrical panel in the west switchgear room began smoking after a breaker fault. The building fire alarm activated automatically and all 34 personnel on shift (28 Basalt Ridge employees, 6 contractors from Ridgeline Structural Engineering performing unrelated structural inspections) evacuated via the marked routes within 4 minutes, per the muster point log. The in-panel fire suppression system (FM-200) discharged automatically and extinguished the fire before it spread beyond the panel enclosure. The local fire department was called as a precaution and cleared the building at 13:45; no fire department suppression action was needed. No injuries were reported among employees or contractors. Building 2 was closed for the remainder of the shift while an electrician assessed the panel; production resumed the next morning.

---
From: Naledi Dube
To: ehs-leadership@basaltridge.example
Subject: Building 2 electrical incident - initial notes
Date: 2026-05-09

Quick update before the full report: everyone's accounted for and safe. Muster took 4 minutes, within our target. FM-200 did exactly what it's supposed to do. If that suppression system had failed to discharge, we could have been looking at a much bigger fire and possible injuries during evacuation -- but that's not what happened here, thankfully. I'll have root cause from the electrician by Friday.

---
From: Colton Baird, VP Operations
To: Naledi Dube
Date: 2026-05-09

Good work getting everyone out fast. For the record, since the Ridgeline contractors were on-site during a Basalt Ridge safety event, do we need to loop in their safety office?

---
From: Naledi Dube
To: Colton Baird
Date: 2026-05-09

Yes, I've already notified Ridgeline's site supervisor since their personnel were present for the evacuation, even though none of them were injured and the incident originated in our equipment, not theirs. Standard practice per our site access agreement.

---
From: Colton Baird
To: Naledi Dube
Date: 2026-05-10

Did Ridgeline's site supervisor have any concerns on their end?

---
From: Naledi Dube
To: Colton Baird
Date: 2026-05-10

No concerns raised. Their supervisor confirmed all 6 of their people were accounted for at muster and none required any medical attention. They asked to be copied on our final root-cause report once the electrician finishes the assessment, which I've agreed to.

---
From: Naledi Dube
To: ehs-leadership@basaltridge.example
Subject: Re: Building 2 electrical incident - root cause
Date: 2026-05-15

Root cause confirmed: a loose lug connection on the breaker caused arcing and localized overheating. Electrician has re-torqued all connections in the panel and performed thermal imaging on the rest of the switchgear room; no other hot spots found. Building 2 is cleared to resume normal two-shift operation starting tomorrow.

Halcyon SaaS Suite -- Data Handling & Offboarding Policy (shared with Ridgeline Structural Engineering during procurement, 2026-03-18)

Data retention: Active account data is retained for the life of the subscription. Upon cancellation, data is retained in a read-only archive state for 30 days, then permanently deleted. Customers may request an export of their data in CSV/JSON format at any time during the subscription or within the 30-day post-cancellation window; exports are not available after permanent deletion.

Deletion requests: Customers may request immediate permanent deletion (bypassing the 30-day archive) via a signed request to legal@halcyon.example; standard processing time is 10 business days.

Backups: Encrypted backups are retained for an additional 35 days beyond the primary deletion for disaster-recovery purposes only, and are not accessible for routine export -- they exist solely to restore service in case of a platform-wide failure, not for individual customer data recovery requests.

Subprocessor access: Our backup storage subprocessor (Glacier Vault Inc.) has encrypted-at-rest access only and no application-level access to readable customer data.

questions.instruction: Which of the following does Halcyon confirm?

candidates.description: Customers can still export their data after it's been permanently deleted
Data is kept in a readable archive state for 30 days after cancellation
A customer can request immediate deletion instead of waiting the standard period

questions.notes: exports are explicitly unavailable after permanent deletion; backups exist only for platform-wide disaster recovery

Incident Report -- Hearthstone Senior Living, Maple Wing
Date: 2026-02-14 | Filed by: Malik Freeman, Charge Nurse

At 03:15, resident Mrs. Odalys Fenn (Room 214) was found on the floor of her room by a night-shift aide during rounds; she had apparently attempted to get up unassisted despite a documented fall-risk care plan requiring staff assistance for all transfers. She sustained a bruise to her left hip; no fracture was found on X-ray taken at County General later that morning as a precaution. She was not hospitalized overnight and returned to her room after the X-ray. No staff member was present at the time of the fall. This is Mrs. Fenn's second fall this quarter; the first (2025-12-03) resulted in no injury. Staff assignment sheets confirm the aide assigned to 15-minute checks on Mrs. Fenn had last checked on her 12 minutes prior to discovery, within the required interval. No equipment malfunction was involved -- her bed alarm was functioning and had not sounded, suggesting she got up quietly enough not to trigger it, or exited from the side without the sensor pad.

questions.instruction: Which of the following does this report confirm?

candidates.description: A staff member was present when the resident fell
This resident has fallen more than once this quarter
A piece of safety equipment failed to work
The resident was hospitalized overnight

questions.notes: no staff was present at the time of the fall; the bed alarm was functioning; she was not hospitalized overnight

questions.instruction: Did the 15-minute check interval requirement get violated before this fall was discovered?
questions.notes: the aide checked 12 minutes prior, which is within the required 15-minute interval
